draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for the update, and glad the first week has gone well so far. Tariq has also followed up on your open cancellation-timing ticket: a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately, so nothing you've already paid for is lost.

You've got a first project created, which is the main thing -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to help you get your real work into Wrenfield and decide whether it's the right fit.

Best,
Priya
